parameters.name: orderRef
parameters.description: The order reference to look up (Task.orderRef, set at creation). Must be non-empty — an empty value is treated as a missing parameter and rejected with 400.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1-500 (default 100). An empty, repeated or out-of-range value is `400 invalid-limit`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque keyset cursor taken from the previous page's `nextCursor` (repeat the filters on every page). A value that does not decode is `400 invalid-cursor`. Any other query parameter is `400 unknown-query-parameter`.
